influences.name: Nicolas Ghesquière
influences.context: I think Nicolas' work straddles the line between fantastical and elegant. There are always crazy references—he told me they were watching a lot of Evangelion [a Japanese anime series] when working on the last collection—but the work is always very stylised and sophisticated. The clothes themselves are extremely high quality. I think I try to accomplish a similar thing in my work, so we vibe.
